External models used by the scripts
===================================

    by the 58th CRM-SIG meeting. Included unchanged. Licence: CC BY 4.0
    (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), as stated in the file.
    Source: https://cidoc-crm.org/Version/version-7.1.3
